description: HARMONIC SIEVE: only retains analysis channels which might hold partials of the specified harmonic series - submode 1 keeps the harmonic series of 'fundamental', suppressing everything else by 'clarity'. Content-verified: a 220 Hz 10-harmonic source sieved at fundamental 220 keeps exactly the 220-multiples (peaks at 219.5/440.9/660.4/879.9/1099.3 Hz, nothing between). fundamental CDP-enforced 10-22050 Hz ('Parameter[1] Value (30000.000000) out of range (10.000000 to 22050.000000)' verbatim) and NOT time-variable ('ERROR: Cannot read parameter 1 [cl.brk]: brkpnt_files not permitted.'); clarity (-c) 0-1 ('Parameter[2] Value (2.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 1.000000)'), default 1, breakpoint-CAPABLE (verified: a 0.2->1 ramp differs from both endpoint renders; banner: 'clarity may vary over time'). Sibling submodes pinned: 2 = octaves only, 3 = odd partials only, 4 = linear frqstep partials from fundamental, 5 = harmonic partials displaced by frqstep (4/5 take an extra frqstep argv - different shape). Duration static (2.0230 in place); deterministic.
musical_use: Tune a LISTENING FILTER to a pitch and hear only what belongs to it: pick is spectral sieving, related to pitch tune but subtractive - where tune RETUNES partials onto a template, pick simply discards whatever could not be part of the series. Set fundamental to the (known or getpitch-measured) pitch of the material to strip bow noise, breath and room from a pitched source into a purified harmonic core; set it to a DIFFERENT pitch to ghost an implied harmony out of a rich texture (whatever partials happen to align with the foreign series survive, an eerie resonance-of-what-isn't-there). clarity is the reveal control: 1 = hard sieve, small values only lean toward it, and a time-varying clarity ramp performs the classic emergence - noise crystallizing into pitch across a phrase. On inharmonic/noisy material the result is a pitched shadow of the original motion, excellent fodder for further spectral work (blur, tune, transposef). Submode 4's linear-step series (execute()) sieves bell-like inharmonic sets instead.

fundamental.description: Fundamental of the harmonic series whose channels are retained. CDP-enforced 10-22050 ('Parameter[1] Value (30000.000000) out of range (10.000000 to 22050.000000)' verbatim; nyquist ceiling input-dependent). NOT time-variable (brk refused 'Cannot read parameter 1 ... brkpnt_files not permitted.'). Set it where the material's energy lives (getpitch or pitchinfo info via execute() can measure it). Required.

clarity.description: Extent to which data in non-series channels is suppressed (CDP-enforced 0-1, refusal verbatim; default 1 = full sieve). BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (0.2->1 ramp differs from both endpoint renders, verified; banner-confirmed). Ramp it for the noise-into-pitch reveal.

examples.description: Purify a pitched source to its harmonic core.
examples.expected_use: Only 220-series channels survive (verified peak set) - breath/noise/room stripped.

examples.description: Crystallize noise onto an implied pitch.
examples.expected_use: The sieve tightens across the file - unpitched material gradually resolves into a 110 Hz harmonic ghost.

known_issues: fundamental is scalar-only (brkpnt_files not permitted, verbatim) - for a moving series, chain segments or use pitch tune (whose template focus is time-variable by other means).
Retention is by CHANNEL: partials falling near series channels survive even if not exact multiples - the sieve is as sharp as the analysis resolution (finer with more analysis points).
Siblings pinned, all execute()-reachable: submode 2 octaves, 3 odd partials (same argv shape); 4 linear frqstep series, 5 displaced harmonics (extra frqstep positional - different shape).
Duration static (2.0230 in place); deterministic (identical data chunks across runs).
Wav input auto-PVOCs through the engine; .ana mono by construction.
